claims.text: TBI: TXA w.in 3 h of inj ↓head injury-related death.
claims.quote: tranexamic acid is safe in patients with TBI and that treatment within 3 h of injury reduces head injury-related death
claims.locator: CRASH-3 trial collaborators. Effects of tranexamic acid on death, disability, vascular occlusive events and other morbidities in patients with acute traumatic brain injury (CRASH-3). Lancet 2019;394(10210):1713-1723
